transformations: Final result records are JSON-reformatted and ZIP-compressed; all numeric values, histories, events and outcome fields are preserved.
Absolute champion_index paths are made relative to the original campaign directory; folder separators become forward slashes.
Per-run benchmark_metadata.json retains all top-level benchmark fields except cells; cell_summary retains the cell fields except the duplicated seeds array.
Prior retry attempts, population snapshots, champion files, logs and the derived workbook are excluded. The original archive remains intact.

All figures and source files are byte-for-byte copies. The initial source manifest predates the documented logging amendment; source.zip includes both source manifests and the pre-amendment benchmark driver.
